summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a Q1 2026 dividend of $2.00 per common share declared by its board of directors. The filing provides administrative details regarding ex-dividend dates and payment mechanics due to CSDR implementation in Norway, with payment expected on June 5, 2026 (VPS shareholders on June 10, 2026). This is a routine dividend declaration, not a change in capital allocation policy or a special situation event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist elements. The filing serves only to inform shareholders of the dividend timetable.
